create.title: Balanced critical two-defect local commutator and forced-ramp obstruction
create.statement_tex: For every persistent critical j=1 literal balanced block with L asymp K asymp X^(1/6), the ordered map (h,k,h',k') to (h,k,p=h'-h,q=k'-k) has multiplicity one and Delta+rho=q(2h+p), Delta-rho=p(2k+q); on character support p=2s and chi_4(h)chi_4(h+p)=(-1)^s. The genuine p=0 and q=0 axes are each absolutely O_epsilon(L^3X^epsilon). For x=h+h', y=k+k', U=qx, V=2sy, the four displayed elementary forward-difference multiplier commutators normalize to shifts. The two displayed ordinary and parity-compatible unnormalized commutators are 2(2y-x)T_sT_q and 8(y-x)T_sT_q^2; every fixed-width singular strip is O_epsilon(L^3X^epsilon), while off the strip division cancels the multiplier and returns only the original alternating shift tautology. On the invariant endpoint rectangle, reality gives the exact bilinear decomposition <W,H>_G=<P_(++)W,P_(++)H>_G+(1/16)<D_hD_kW,D_hD_kH>_G; the mixed projections vanish but the (++) complement retains L^4X^epsilon available positive capacity. The exact coefficient-independent mixed Abel identity has a q-primitive whose supremum is at least N/2 on an N-point ambient geometric/profile interval, so at N asymp L the currently accepted positive geometric-support and gate-face owners can lose the missing factor L. Both arithmetic low-gcd weights remain in the coefficient, fixed-Q rulings survive, and aliases/lifts remain corner-dependent if opened. This is a no-go only for the displayed local coefficient-independent commutator, independent-swap, and two-step Abel placements followed by positive closure. It is not a physical lower bound, a disproof of the critical remainder, or a classification of weighted, composite, nonlocal, or actual-symbol commutators.
